{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay, MVar, newMVar, readMVar, modifyMVar_, takeMVar, putMVar)
import Control.Concurrent.Chan (Chan, newChan, writeChan, readChan)
import Control.Exception (bracket, finally, SomeException, catch)
import Control.Monad (forever, void, when)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime)
import System.IO (Handle, hClose, hFlush, hPutStrLn, openFile, IOMode(..), hIsClosed)

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { aeTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , aeSessionId :: Int
  , aeMessage :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

data SessionState = Active | Draining | Closed deriving (Eq, Show)

data Session = Session
  { sessId :: Int
  , sessState :: IORef SessionState
  , sessAuditHandle :: IORef Handle
  , sessBuffer :: IORef [AuditEntry]
  }

data AuditSystem = AuditSystem
  { asFlushChan :: Chan (Session, [AuditEntry])
  , asSessionRegistry :: MVar [(Int, Session)]
  }

initAuditSystem :: IO AuditSystem
initAuditSystem = do
  flushChan <- newChan
  registry <- newMVar []
  let sys = AuditSystem flushChan registry
  void $ forkIO (flushWorker sys)
  return sys

flushWorker :: AuditSystem -> IO ()
flushWorker sys = forever $ do
  (session, entries) <- readChan (asFlushChan sys)
  state <- readIORef (sessState session)
  -- Worker processes entries regardless of session state
  -- because entries were already validated at enqueue time
  handleRef <- readIORef (sessAuditHandle session)
  mapM_ (writeAuditEntry handleRef) entries
    `catch` (\e -> putStrLn $ "Flush error: " ++ show (e :: SomeException))

writeAuditEntry :: Handle -> AuditEntry -> IO ()
writeAuditEntry h entry = do
  hPutStrLn h $ show (aeTimestamp entry) ++ " [" ++ show (aeSessionId entry) ++ "] " ++ T.unpack (aeMessage entry)
  hFlush h

createSession :: AuditSystem -> Int -> IO Session
createSession sys sid = do
  h <- openFile ("/tmp/audit_" ++ show sid ++ ".log") AppendMode
  hRef <- newIORef h
  stateRef <- newIORef Active
  bufRef <- newIORef []
  let session = Session sid stateRef hRef bufRef
  modifyMVar_ (asSessionRegistry sys) $ \reg -> return ((sid, session) : reg)
  return session

auditLog :: AuditSystem -> Session -> Text -> IO ()
auditLog sys session msg = do
  state <- readIORef (sessState session)
  when (state == Active) $ do
    now <- getCurrentTime
    let entry = AuditEntry now (sessId session) msg
    modifyIORef' (sessBuffer session) (entry :)
    buf <- readIORef (sessBuffer session)
    when (length buf >= 3) $ do
      writeIORef (sessBuffer session) []
      writeChan (asFlushChan sys) (session, buf)

closeSession :: AuditSystem -> Session -> IO ()
closeSession sys session = do
  writeIORef (sessState session) Draining
  -- Flush remaining buffer
  buf <- readIORef (sessBuffer session)
  when (not $ null buf) $ do
    writeChan (asFlushChan sys) (session, buf)
    writeIORef (sessBuffer session) []
  -- Transition to closed and release handle
  writeIORef (sessState session) Closed
  h <- readIORef (sessAuditHandle session)
  hClose h
  -- Remove from registry
  modifyMVar_ (asSessionRegistry sys) $ \reg ->
    return $ filter ((/= sessId session) . fst) reg

simulateWebSocket :: AuditSystem -> Int -> IO ()
simulateWebSocket sys sid = do
  session <- createSession sys sid
  auditLog sys session "Connection established"
  auditLog sys session "Handshake complete"
  auditLog sys session "Processing request 1"
  auditLog sys session "Processing request 2"
  threadDelay 1000
  auditLog sys session "Processing request 3"
  closeSession sys session

main :: IO ()
main = do
  sys <- initAuditSystem
  mapM_ (\i -> forkIO (simulateWebSocket sys i)) [1..5]
  threadDelay 2000000
  putStrLn "Server shutdown complete"
